subject: Judge: review pluggable LLM-backend abstraction + Claude provider
description: Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge review mode) of the backend-abstraction attempt branch. Fetch the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff) and apply the rubric: clean adapter interface (kind agentic-cli|api; the documented methods present); lib/claude-cli.js correctly refactored into the Claude provider WITHOUT breaking its existing named exports (headless-drain.js + onboard-learn.js must still work — check the re-exports); getActiveBackend reads overlay.config.backend and defaults to Claude; API-provider seam is a clean stub (not half-built); tests present + meaningful; scope limited to the seam + Claude provider (no drain-routing/dashboard/config changes leaked in). Under the feature, APPROVE auto-merges the attempt into the feature branch (merge_attempt, auto-aborts on conflict); KICK BACK = set_status failed + a wired record_decision. NEVER force-merge.
